messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "call your doctor if your hives do not improve after 3 days"
set: ["call your doctor if your hives do not improve after 3 days", "tell your doctor if your symptoms do not improve", "call doctor if symptoms do not improve", "call doctor if symptoms do not improve after 6 weeks", "call your doctor if symptoms do not improve or if they get worse", "call your doctor if they do not itch", "call your doctor if your anxiety does not improve or if it gets worse", "tell doctor if symptoms do not improve within 7 days", "tell your doctor if these do not settle", "call your doctor if condition does not improve or gets worse while using this medicine", "call your doctor if you experience agitation", "call your doctor for instructions", "do not change your dose", "call your doctor if you experience panic attacks", "call your doctor at once if you have", "call your doctor if you experience extreme worry"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "call your doctor if your symptoms do not improve",
    "call doctor if symptoms do not improve",
    "call your doctor if symptoms do not improve or if they get worse",
    "call your doctor if your anxiety does not improve or if it gets worse",
    "call your doctor if condition does not improve or gets worse while using this medicine",
    "call your doctor if you experience agitation",
    "call your doctor if you experience panic attacks",
    "call your doctor at once if you have",
    "call your doctor if you experience extreme worry"
  ],
  "alias": "call your doctor if your hives do not improve after 3 days"
}
